items.t: Target (TGT) Turns To Consumer Brands Veteran Sally Grimes For Board Insight
items.sum: Target (NYSE:TGT) appointed consumer brands executive Sally Grimes as an independent director to its board. Grimes previously served as CEO of Diageo North America and CEO of Clif Bar, leading large-scale consumer products businesses.
